notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
1.3 - Changelog:

Added:

Full controller support

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
1.2.0 - Changelog:

Added:
- New Casual Mode
- Discards now has refresh button
- Merchant Guild now synergize with Fish Shops increasing gold from sale

Changed:
- Graveyard changes:
[code]Discard 3 cards from Deck
->
Discard 10 cards from Deck
Reaction: Discard cards from Hand[/code]
- Crypt changes:
[code]Discard 10 cards from Deck
->
Discard any number of cards from Deck[/code]

Fixed:
- Fixed Theater not doubling cards in some cases
- Fixed Decoration placement condition
- Fixed Deconstruct description

Thank you all for your feedback; it helps us make the game better.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
1.1.0 - Changelog:

Added:
- Added save slots
- Display road length
- Display additional effects when inspecting buildings on the map
- Buy actions now shows different cards

Changed:
- Cottage completing region changes:
[code]30% chance +1 Townhouse 
->
+2 Townhouse[/code]
- Butchery changes: 
[code]Discard 3 cards 
->
+1 Card when placing nearby[/code]
- Townhouse changes:
[code]+2 Quarry +1 Lumberyard II 
-> 
+2 Street +1 Lumberyard II[/code]
- Lumberyard II changes:
[code]+2 Pier or +2 Boardwalk 
-> 
+1 Pier or +1 Cottage[/code]
- Pier changes:
[code]+2 Land for each water and +1 Fish Shop 
-> 
+2 Land for each water, +2 Fish Shop or +1 Boardwalk[/code]
- Estate changes:
[code]+2 Workshop or +2 Shop 
-> 
+2 Quarry, +1 Workshop or +1 Shop[/code]
- Manor changes:
[code] +1 School or +2 Avenue or +2 Fortress 
->
 +1 Architect Guild or +1 School[/code]
- Villa changes:
[code]no effect 
-> 
+1 Library or +1 Theater[/code]

Fixed:
- Fixed incorrect tips for reactions (building nearby road, guilds, etc..)
- Fixed stacking wall onto each other
- Fixed not updating highlights during building
- Fixed freeze when building large walls
- Fixed wrong description for Cathedral
- Fixed visual bug with Lumberyard II displayed as Lumberyard I
- Fixed visual bug with Gates 

Thank you all for your feedback; it helps us make the game better.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.8
notes.notes:
0.4.8 - Changelog:

 Fixed bug that prevented settings from being saved in the main menu
 Added a list of key bindings in the settings menu
 Resolved an issue with placing multiple castles
 Removed the option to delete the castle
 Introduced a setting to adjust animation speed
 Added an option to show or hide the number of cards in the deck
 Players can now continue playing even after completing the final stage of the castle
 Added a new soundtrack and sound effects for minor actions
 Enhanced the icons for better clarity


Thank you all for your feedback; it helps us make the game better.

notes.notes:

0.4.4 - Changelog:

 Fixed issue where “Game Over” would appear even with actions still available.
 Castle cards now reshuffle when discarded using the Tavern.
 The Mill now only harvests completed fields.
 Fields gathered using the House are now less random.
 Added smooth animations for discarding and gathering cards.
 Fixed UI bugs that could break gameplay.
 Added button navigation through keyboard in menus.


Thank you all for your feedback; it helps us make the game better.
